title: Derived Information + Knowledge Graph Schema (IDs required)

doc_id.description: Same UUID as the base document; join key between layers.

filename.description: The name of the source PDF file.

filepath.description: Original or canonical path to the related PDF (optional).

extractor_version.description: Semantic/string version of the extractor used.

extraction_date.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when extraction occurred.

extraction_metadata.description: Extractor version, date, and confidence scores by area.

summary.description: Concise product synopsis combining high-level sales + technical context.

sales_summary.description: Short pitch for sales users (value props, where it wins).

technical_summary.description: Short technical digest for engineers (properties, performance, caveats).

key_applications.description: Key applications distilled to unique values.

derived_info.description: Summaries and persona-specific blurbs derived from the bulletin.

entities.description: Typed, deduplicated entities with IDs, canonical names, provenance, and metadata.

kg_triples.description: Subject–predicate–object facts; objects may be entity refs or property/value pairs.

knowledge_graph.description: Entities and triples representing structured relationships.

description: Derived analysis layer plus knowledge graph built on top of the base extraction.
